messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PD alert: high 5xx rate detected for service=auth-proxy-prod (window=10m)
incidentbot: signal: 5xx_rate=6.2% (baseline 0.3%), error_type=502, affected_region=us-west1, sample_pct=3% 
incidentbot: link: https://console.telemetry/redwood/alerts/1713131313

pagerbot: automated runbook triggered: check-kv-proxy, check-upstream, increase-log-level

jamie: acked — taking lead (jamie_oncall)
jamie: quick checks: infra looks healthy, k8s pods stable, but auth-proxy is returning a steady stream of upstream 502s

marta: @jamie grabbing traces, forwarding span ids. seeing a spike of `connection reset by peer` on the auth-proxy -> user-db upstream
marta: sample log: `2026-06-18T03:41:02Z auth-proxy ERROR upstream request failed: read tcp 10.1.2.3:443: connection reset by peer`

jamie: thanks. rolling a temporary traffic-shift to reduce load on user-db pool: `kubectl patch svc auth-proxy -p '{\"spec\":{\"weight\":{\"user-db\":50}}}'` (will watch)

anita: adding context: cust-impact - API error rate bump observed for token-introspect calls, some customers seeing failed logins (~2% of auth traffic in last 5m). CS notified (cc @luis)

luis: confirming customer tickets: small spike but a few enterprise users report login failures. asking for ETA to update them.

jamie: doing a canary rollback of the last deploy to auth-proxy v2.7.1 -> v2.7.0; canary started at 03:45Z

marta: traces show latency window aligning with deploy at 03:44Z, lots of retried upstream connections. tagging as probable deploy regression

kevin: @jamie if rollback doesn't drop 5xx within 5-10m, escalate and swap to fallback routing (route to standby cluster) — I'm ready to run the swap

jamie: canary rollback complete, traffic shifted back to v2.7.0 at 03:52Z

incidentbot: update: 5xx rate decreased to 0.6% (5m avg) — still above baseline but trending down

jamie: monitoring... looks like error rate nearly back to normal. keeping incident open for postmortem.

anita: noting customer impact: minor login disruption for ~15 customers, none critical SLA breaches (so far). CS will send interim note saying we identified a deploy-related issue and rolled back

kevin: nice work. once we confirm stable for 30m, I'll close the PD alert and schedule a postmortem with release engineering and SRE

marta: saved traces + sample logs to: https://s3.redwood/traces/authproxy/1713131313.zip

jamie: thanks all. handoff in 45m to second-shift oncall. leaving a short checklist in the incident doc: items -> verify 5xx < 0.5%, confirm user-db pod health, run `curl -I` smoke tests for token-introspect endpoint

incidentbot: PD note: incident acknowledged by jamie at 1713131320, auto-escalation suppressed

luis: CS will post a customer update at 04:30Z. please ping if anything changes.
__notes: Generated synthetic slack thread for incidents channel about automated paging for HTTP 5xx spike. All fields are strings or list of strings as required.
